faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Inspiron 7590 and 7591 2-in-1, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this the UK or US layout?
faqs.answer: This is the UK English layout, with the UK-specific key arrangement (£ symbol, enter key shape).

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
